entries.name: G0D.WORDS
entries.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
entries.note: space-separated String -> Vector of its non-empty words

entries.name: G0C.ORDERS
entries.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
entries.note: Parse the orders JSON String into the Vector of order Records.

entries.name: G0A.UNWORDS
entries.body: [ ' ' 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
entries.note: Vector of space-free words -> one String joined by single spaces

entries.name: G0D.SHIFT
entries.body: 'SV' BIND SV 0 GET 1 COLLECT SV -1 DROP CONCAT
entries.note: V -> same-length Vector of each lane's previous element, first lane repeating V[0]

entries.name: G0D.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'DK' BIND 1 DK RANGE [ 'DD' BIND DK DD DIV FLOOR DD MUL DK EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: positive integer -> ascending Vector of its positive divisors

entries.name: G0D.RUNS
entries.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV G0D.SHIFT SUB [ 'D' BIND 0 1 D 0 EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN RV GROUP VALUES
entries.note: numeric V -> Vector of its maximal runs of equal adjacent values, each run a Vector, in order

entries.name: G0A.BSTEP
entries.body: 'G0A.SK' BIND 'G0A.SA' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 'O' 'O' '(' '[' ] RECORD G0A.SK GET 'G0A.SQ' BIND G0A.SA G0A.SK 2 COLLECT JOIN G0A.SA CHARS -1 DROP JOIN 'X' G0A.SA CHARS -1 GET G0A.SQ EQ SELECT G0A.SQ 'O' EQ SELECT
entries.note: bracket-matching step: stack String (base '#', failure 'X') and a bracket char -> next stack String

entries.name: G0B.REDUCE
entries.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
entries.note: String of brackets in, the String left after deleting adjacent () and [] pairs six times (enough for 12 chars).

entries.name: G0C.BSTEP
entries.body: 'GSC' BIND 'GSS' BIND GSS GSS LENGTH 1 SUB GET 'GST' BIND GST GSC 2 COLLECT JOIN 'GSQ' BIND GSQ '()' EQ NOT GSQ '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT 'GSM' BIND GSS GSS LENGTH 1 SUB TAKE GSS GSC 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 GSM SELECT GET
entries.note: One bracket-stack step: (stack, char) to stack. Pops when top and char form a matched pair, else pushes the char. Stack starts with a '$' sentinel.

entries.name: G0D.MOD
entries.body: 'MB' BIND 'MA' BIND MA MA MB DIV FLOOR MB MUL SUB
entries.note: a b G0D.MOD -> a modulo b (a - b*floor(a/b))

entries.name: G0D.BRACKET-STACK
entries.body: CHARS [ 'x' ] [ 'BC' BIND 'BA' BIND BA BC 1 COLLECT CONCAT BA -1 DROP 2 COLLECT 1 0 BA -1 GET [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 'z' 'z' '(' '[' ] RECORD BC GET EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD
entries.note: bracket String -> Vector left after cancelling adjacent matched pairs, with sentinel 'x' at the bottom (balanced iff equal to [ 'x' ])

entries.name: G0D.JOIN-WITH
entries.body: 'SEP' BIND [ 'JX' BIND SEP JX 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN CHARS SEP CHARS LENGTH DROP JOIN
entries.note: words sep G0D.JOIN-WITH -> the Strings joined with sep between them (words non-empty)

entries.name: G0A.BSCAN
entries.body: CHARS '#' [ G0A.BSTEP ] SCAN
entries.note: bracket String -> Vector of matching stacks after each char; '#' marks a balanced prefix

entries.name: G0A.RUNS
entries.body: 'G0A.RV' BIND G0A.RV G0A.RV 1 TAKE G0A.RV -1 DROP CONCAT SUB 'G0A.RD' BIND G0A.RD G0A.RD MUL 1 MIN 0 [ ADD ] SCAN G0A.RV GROUP VALUES
entries.note: integer Vector -> Vector of its maximal runs of equal adjacent values, each a Vector

entries.name: G0B.DIVISORS
entries.body: 'DVN' BIND 1 DVN RANGE 'DVS' BIND DVS 0 DVN DVS DIV 'DVQ' BIND DVQ FLOOR DVQ SUB 0 LT NOT SELECT [ 0 GT ] FILTER
entries.note: Positive integer in, ascending Vector of its positive divisors out.

entries.name: G0C.RLE
entries.body: 'RV' BIND RV 1 DROP RV 0 GET 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA LENGTH 1 SUB 'RL' BIND RA RL GET 'RP' BIND RA RL RP 0 GET RP 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT PUT RA RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RP 0 GET RX EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD
entries.note: Run-length encoding of a non-empty Vector of integers as [ value count ] pairs, via FOLD over a pair accumulator.

entries.name: G0C.DIVS
entries.body: 'GDK' BIND 1 GDK RANGE [ 'GDD' BIND GDK GDD DIV 'GDQ' BIND GDQ FLOOR GDQ EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: Positive divisors of a positive integer, ascending.

entries.name: G0C.REV
entries.body: [ 'OX' BIND OX 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'OY' BIND OY 'qty' GET OY 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
entries.note: Total of qty times price over the order Records that have a price (exact rational).

entries.name: G0D.BALANCED
entries.body: G0D.BRACKET-STACK [ 'x' ] EQ
entries.note: bracket String -> TRUE when properly balanced

entries.name: G0D.GAPS
entries.body: [ 'GE' BIND 1 0 GE NIL? SELECT ] MAP G0D.RUNS [ 0 GET 1 EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: Vector with NILs -> Vector of the runs of consecutive NILs (each run a Vector of 1s)

entries.name: G0A.BINARY
entries.body: 'G0A.BN' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] 'G0A.BP' BIND G0A.BN G0A.BP DIV FLOOR 'G0A.BQ' BIND G0A.BQ G0A.BQ 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 0 G0A.BP [ G0A.BN GT NOT ] FILTER LENGTH SUB TAKE STR JOIN
entries.note: integer 1..63 -> base-2 String without leading zeros

entries.name: G0A.BSTACK
entries.body: CHARS '#' [ G0A.BSTEP ] FOLD
entries.note: bracket String -> final matching stack; equals '#' exactly when balanced

entries.name: G0B.COLSTEP
entries.body: 'CX' BIND CX 3 MUL 1 ADD CX 2 DIV CX CX 2 DIV FLOOR 2 MUL SUB 0 GT SELECT 1 CX 1 GT SELECT
entries.note: One Collatz step on x, staying at 1 once 1 is reached.

entries.name: G0B.FILLSTEP
entries.body: 'FE' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FE FE NIL? SELECT
entries.note: acc elem in: elem if present, else acc (for SCAN forward fill).

entries.name: G0B.TITLECASE
entries.body: 'TW' BIND TW CHARS 0 GET UPPER TW CHARS 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
entries.note: Lower-case word in, same word with first letter upper-cased.

entries.name: G0C.PRIMES
entries.body: 'GPN' BIND 1 GPN RANGE [ 'GPK' BIND GPK G0C.DIVS LENGTH 2 EQ ] FILTER
entries.note: Primes less than or equal to a positive integer, ascending (uses G0C.DIVS).

entries.name: G0D.PRIME
entries.body: G0D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
entries.note: positive integer -> TRUE when prime
